name: checkSkillCirt
description: Checks if a skill attack scores a critical hit. Unlike checkHit, this only checks crit (no miss calculation) and uses a strict less-than comparison instead of less-than-or-equal.

formula_steps.note: Uses strict '<' instead of '<=' unlike other check functions — this means probability of 1/10000 can never trigger (roll=0 is not < 0+1... actually roll=0 IS < 1, so it can trigger but with marginally lower chance than '<=' would give)
